title: Wonderful tour of the beautiful city of Seville!
text: Enjoyed learning all about the great city of Seville! Tour guide was knowledgeable and engaging! Would definitely recommend!
author: Janine_M

title: Excellent tour!
text: Well worth booking. An excellent trip with Alberto who spoke excellent English which really helped! A great tour! Thank you
author: Jane_W

title: Best way to start our visit!
text: This was the best way to spend our first afternoon in the city. We visited sights but more than that we came to learn a little. It also highlighted things that we returned to like the food market. Our guide was informed and interesting.
author: TamworthPaul

title: A birds-eye view of Seville.
text: We had one day to explore Seville. This tour with a local tour guide gave us more that. We saw the highlights but also the local neighborhoods.
author: Jacobus_P

title: Tuk Tuk Driver In local actor.
text: What an amazing Truck Tuk tour thru Sevilla. Alvaro was very well-versed and knowledgeable of Sevilla. My wife and I were very impressed with the history he shared with us. He communicated. Easily with us in English as well as Spanish.  Job well done.
author: Rudy_T

title: Great experience!
text:
A little challenging to find and the meeting point is in a very humid car park so don’t arrive too early. 
Fantastic driver Noelia who despite being new gave us a smooth and informative tour which covered in more detail some of the great sights in Seville. Worth doing in addition to the hop on bus for a different perspective!
author: Explorer58736901674

title: Great host and showed us some hidden gems
text: Great host and showed us some hidden gems. We have been to Sevilla before there was a lot more to see that we hadn’t known about the city
author: B6781XDpatr

title: Seville by Tuk Tuk
text: The Tuk Tuk was a lot of fun and a great way to see the city and learn about the history without having having to walk many kilometers
author: Dawn_T

title: Jlm55
text: The tour guide was excellent. He was very knowledgeable of everything he showed us and even knew the history of a lot of things that we asked about. I would recommend him to family and friends.
author: Jose_M

title: Had fun!
text: Very informative and a great way to see the sights in a moving Tuk Tuk with a breeze.  Thanks for the tour.
author: Janie_B
